skill_name: Write an essay on the three major sociological theories
workflow: The three major sociological theories are structural functionalism, symbolic interactionism and conflict theory. Structural functionalism is a sociological theory that explains how social structures and social functions are bound together. Its premise is that society is composed of systems that interact to maintain stability.
